notes:
Mid-market product org building an outbound SDR / sales-assistant that can: 1) stream partial responses to UI within <300ms perceived latency, 2) call tools (update CRM, send email, create calendar invites) reliably, 3) fall back to cheaper model when Dedicated capacity constrained. Preference: start on Hosted API for speed-to-value then evaluate Dedicated for predictable throughput and lower unit costs.

Shorthand from calls: 
- 'Streaming is non-negotiable' — wants progressive token stream + immediate tool triggers (e.g., after intent detected).
- Latency target: interactive SLO ~200-350ms per chunk (95th percentile) for UI streaming; end-to-end action (CRM update) <1s ideally.
- Cost sensitivity: willing to commit for Dedicated if unit economics reduce TCO by ~30-40% vs Hosted at scale.

Security/compliance: must have SSO (SAML), audit logs for all tool calls, and KMS for keys. Data residency: EU customers for some accounts (multi-region routing needed).

POC scope agreed: 2-week POC on Hosted API ingesting 6 months CRM+calendar; measure 95th% latency for streaming and tool call success rate; baseline quality against current in-house model. If results hit SLOs and pricing acceptable, move to Dedicated pilot.

Quotes / verbatim:
- AE note: 'If streaming + tool-calls work at scale, this replaces our brittle lambda orchestration'
- Director of Product: 'Need demo with Salesforce + Gmail tool integration — was explicit about audit trail for every outbound email.'
poc_details: POC deliverables: sample dataset (CRM+calendar), Hosted API integration + sample tool adapters (Salesforce, Gmail, Google Calendar), dashboard of token-level latency and tool-call success rates, cost-per-1000-requests estimate. Duration: 2 weeks. Success criteria: 95th% stream-chunk latency <=350ms, tool-call success >=99%, integrated audit logs available.
commercial_notes: Requested Hosted API pricing for ramp (10k -> 200k monthly queries) and Dedicated starter tier with burst to 4x capacity. Finance flagged need for committed discount tiers and invoice cadence. Legal requested standard DPA + data residency clauses. Expect decision window May 2026 if POC successful.
